notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello all!

This should fix all the crash issues with achievements. Sorry again that this went untended for a bit, we'll keep a sharper eye on the crash report discussion thread from now on.

Have a squishy weekend!

Squidlit Ink.

notes.title: Patch v1.00.4
notes.notes:
Hello! Some minor updates for all you squishies out there.


The Muffin spiders have received extra feign death lessons, and will now fake it like a pro.
Fweehoo would sometimes leave mid-conversation. We've told them that is rude, so that shouldn't happen anymore.
The residents of Squishu were very camera shy, but have gained a lot of confidence recently. Taking screenshots through Steam should work properly now.


Have a squishy day!
